description.value:
(Prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can't Have Another Dragonmark Feat)

The Mark of Making of House Cannith manifests on your skin. You gain the following benefits.

Artisan's Intuition. When you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check or an ability check using Artisan's Tools, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

Spellsmith. You know the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMending000]{Mending} cantrip. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicWeapo]{Magic Weapon} is also always prepared for you: you can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast it with any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat).

Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spells on the Mark of Making Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

Foundry Note

The effect Artisan's Intuition adds the 1d4 to the Arcana checks; add it yourself to the checks using Artisan's Tools. The Spells of the Mark are not added to your class spell list automatically: prepare them from the compendium if your class can.
